players.product: Temporary bonding / debonding systems for wafer thinning and coaters / developers for advanced packaging (WLP / PLP)

connects_to.relationship: semiconductor process equipment supplied to TSMC (Process Equipment segment)

contracts.signal: Major customer table: sales to Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd were JPY 10,918,783 thousand, 30.8% of Tazmo's FY2025 net sales (Process Equipment segment), up from JPY 3,780,050 thousand, 10.5%, in FY2024.
contracts.value: JPY 10,918,783 thousand; 30.8% of net sales (FY2024: JPY 3,780,050 thousand; 10.5%)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (year to December 2025) results: net sales JPY 35,428 million (-1.2% YoY), operating income JPY 4,768 million (-19.4%), ordinary profit JPY 5,009 million (-16.5%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 3,541 million (-16.6%); profit fell on a sharp sales decline in some divisions. Management states that capex in servers for generative AI kept expanding and demand for semiconductor equipment for advanced packaging led the market. Sales by region: Japan JPY 17,015,256 thousand, Taiwan JPY 12,929,138 thousand, China JPY 1,628,458 thousand, South Korea JPY 854,782 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 35,428,641 thousand (98.8% of prior year); operating income JPY 4,768,771 thousand; ordinary profit JPY 5,009,026 thousand; Taiwan sales JPY 12,929,138 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 segment results: Process Equipment net sales JPY 27,475 million (-4.4%), operating income JPY 4,089 million (-25.4%). Within it, Semiconductor Equipment JPY 17,212 million (+39.7%), broadly on plan as previously ordered equipment for advanced packaging and for power semiconductors was accepted smoothly; Transfer Equipment JPY 7,657 million (-7.9%) on lower demand from semiconductor equipment makers; Cleaning Equipment JPY 1,756 million (-68.8%) on weak wafer-maker capex; Coater JPY 848 million (-65.5%) with almost no flat-panel-display capex. Molds & Resin Molding JPY 1,198 million (+53.8%), operating income JPY 56 million; Surface Treatment Equipment (printed circuit board plating / circuit-forming equipment) JPY 6,754 million (+6.3%), operating income JPY 602 million (+4.1%) as large past projects were accepted.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor Equipment sales JPY 17,212,301 thousand (139.7% of prior year); Process Equipment JPY 27,475,899 thousand (95.6%); segment profit JPY 4,089,859 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 orders received JPY 23,938,781 thousand (88.6% of the prior year) and year-end order backlog JPY 19,658,184 thousand (63.1%); Semiconductor Equipment orders JPY 10,968,638 thousand (84.8%), backlog JPY 11,789,534 thousand (65.4%); Transfer Equipment orders JPY 6,749,496 thousand, backlog JPY 2,816,997 thousand. Production (at manufacturing cost) JPY 25,100,612 thousand (102.7%), of which Semiconductor Equipment JPY 11,267,452 thousand (157.0%). Management states that despite AI-related demand, orders were hit by the delayed recovery of memory and logic and weak wafer-maker capex, so the Process Equipment backlog fell year on year.
quarterly_data.figure: Orders received JPY 23,938,781 thousand (88.6%); order backlog JPY 19,658,184 thousand (63.1%); Semiconductor Equipment backlog JPY 11,789,534 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Company management targets for FY2026 (year to December 2026), based on the February 13, 2026 results forecast: net sales JPY 35,500 million and ordinary profit JPY 3,500 million, against FY2025 actuals of JPY 35,428 million and JPY 5,009 million. Management states that AI-chip demand keeps inquiries for advanced-packaging equipment strong, while moves to postpone capex plans were seen as power-semiconductor demand slowed; under the TAZMO Vision 2025 mid-term plan, FY2025 sales missed plan while profit was broadly as planned.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 targets: net sales JPY 35,500 million; ordinary profit JPY 3,500 million

quarterly_data.signal: Capex JPY 1,520 million in FY2025 (Process Equipment JPY 1,339 million, mainly acquiring a factory and equipment development). Capex plan (new / expansion) for the year to December 2026: JPY 7,000 million, of which Process Equipment JPY 6,200 million (demo equipment for semiconductor manufacturing JPY 2,400 million, acquisition of land and buildings JPY 3,200 million, production-equipment renewal JPY 600 million), Molds & Resin Molding JPY 300 million, Surface Treatment Equipment JPY 40 million, other JPY 460 million.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 capex JPY 1,520 million; FY2026 capex plan JPY 7,000 million (Process Equipment JPY 6,200 million)

quarterly_data.signal: R&D expenses JPY 732 million in FY2025, centred on Process Equipment development. Semiconductor R&D themes: coaters, equipment for advanced packaging, single-wafer cleaning equipment and other semiconductor process equipment, new wafer-transfer mechanisms and nanoimprint-related equipment, which the company aims to establish as profitable businesses early.
